source.accepted_proposal: Next step named in the thread: carry method-condition gaps and other unresolved items through the G008 ledger to the DH handoff. Plan recorded in /mnt/project-files/data-part/Data_框架说明.md section T.

design.items: Open CC019 warnings from main.json (ids unchanged, original record kept verbatim) and Data findings whose required_by is later than the step that raised them (DC-U###, DH-U###). Statuses: NOT_FOUND, SEARCH_INCOMPLETE, DEFERRED, AMBIGUOUS, CONFLICT, OPEN_FINDING.
design.due_steps: DC-review decides items due BEFORE_QC; DH-handoff decides items due BEFORE_EDA. Later phases belong to downstream modules; Data only forwards them.
design.outcomes: RESOLVED needs exact evidence; LIMITATION_ACCEPTED needs a stated limitation; ESCALATED becomes a HUMAN_REVIEW finding at the item's phase and keeps that gate closed; CARRIED must name a later phase. Each outcome is appended to the item's history with the input artifact references it relied on.
design.forwarding: Each eda/pk/index handoff carries unresolved_items (all OPEN, CARRIED or ESCALATED items, unchanged), accepted_limitations and the ledger reference. Historical assessments without a ledger fall back to the open warnings in main.json.

rule_changes: dc_coverage.json 1.2.0 adds DC006; dh_handoff.json 1.1.0 adds DH004.
code_changes: data_agents.py: DC-review and DH-handoff receive unresolved_ledger and due_item_ids and return ledger_outcomes; adequacy/unresolved_ledger.json and data_preparation/unresolved_ledger.json; adequacy.json, qc_context.json, data_report.json and each handoff reference the ledger.
tests/test_data_agents.py: 8 ledger cases; fixture returns outcomes; DC/DH rule lists.
